title: Recombinant Protein Affinity Purification With SDS-PAGE QC

source_steps.summary: Lyse the bacterial pellet, clarify the lysate, and retain input QC material.
Equilibrate the nickel resin and discard the flowthrough.
Bind the clarified lysate to the resin and collect flowthrough.
Wash the resin three times and pool the washes.
Prepare five fraction samples for SDS-PAGE.
Heat and briefly centrifuge the prepared samples.
Load samples and ladder into assigned lanes.
Separate, stain, destain, and image the gel.
Record lane-level QC and return the fractions and readout.

semantic_boundaries.label: Protein-purification interpretation
